blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Police arrested a man after he surrendered a carbine with nine rounds of ammunition during a follow-up operation into a reported armed incident on Suguicay Island in Bulalacao town, Oriental Mindoro on Wednesday, Oct. 7. The Bulalacao Municipal Police Station (MPS) said the operation stemmed from information provided by a concerned citizen about unidentified individuals seen on Suguicay Island in Barangay San Juan, with one reportedly carrying a firearm. Police conducted verification and follow-up investigation and learned that a land dispute involving the area was pending before the 3rd Municipal Circuit Trial Court in Mansalay, Oriental Mindoro.
